UWSGI_PORT.description: The port the UWSGI daemon binds to

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the UWSGI configuration file

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to the Zaqar application configuration file used by UWSGI

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to an external config file to extract bind IP and port from. If empty, defaults are used.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section name in the external config file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for IP in the external config file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for port in the external config file

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for worker count in the external config file

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user to run the service as

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group to run the service as

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the main Zaqar configuration file

USE_SYSLOG.description: Whether to use syslog for logging. Set to 'yes' to enable.

USE_LOGFILE.description: Whether to use a log file. Set to 'no' to disable.
